name: foodflow
description: FoodFlow — food delivery management platform (modular monolith)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run migrate && npm run seed
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w backend && npm run test:coverage -w frontend
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend -- --fix
